shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pattern (register divider)
profile figures arranged in a row
row of repeated arch-like or rectangular units resembling architecture
justification: Both are shallow stone reliefs organised by a horizontal banded register of repeated units, above or beside which profile figures are set out in a row, and both include a small disc and repeated arch-like forms. But A is a long, framed, finely incised narrative frieze of human figures and buildings displayed on a museum wall, while B is a chunky, weathered upright block carved in bolder rounded relief with animal forms in situ among rubble — the treatment, format and subject matter differ fundamentally.
